notes.title: Version 2.0.5 - crash + UI bug fix
notes.content:
Fixed a UI bug + crash where opening the pause menu made the fastforward button stop working.

Keep reporting any crashes you hit and we'll keep trying to fix them!
- Darzington ✨

notes.title: Version 2.0.4 - crash fix
notes.content: Fixed a crash in the Cult of the Dark One scenario when two heroes come to warn you about your performance on the same night. Thanks to the player who reported it! o7

notes.title: Quest Giver 2.0.3 - Optional Crash Reporting
notes.content:
Hey, I've added a simple window that displays a crash report, with a button that let's you send it to me! Should be useful if there are any Quest Giver bugs still lingering :P 
- Zal

notes.title: Version 1.2.2: Fancy text & minor bug fixes
notes.content:
Hey folks, just some quick bug fixes:

 Fixed several UI input bugs (including one submitted by TheChronicleHunter, thanks!)
 Fixed an incorrect note in one of the scenario songs
 Fixed an unlikely but devastating crash in the music engine

Plus we've dotted some cool text effects around the game for special dialogue:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44697663/4b8724c282964b77d9c21d920fb8d8bca21e860b.gif

That's it for now, but we've got something fun coming down the pipeline, to be announced soon!

notes.title: Version 1.2.1: Beginner-friendliness patch
notes.content: Added the seer, a character who makes the “World Needs a Hero” scenario more beginner-friendly.

notes.title: Version 1.2: SFX, QoL, and a Discord Server!
notes.content:
We’ve just launched our Discord server! Hop in to chat about Quest Giver and get a sneak peak at our next project 🤫

Version 1.2 includes:

 New sound effects, especially during the end of day results
 Hints for various input modes when the game is first launched
 Mouse QoL: use the scroll wheel when viewing heroes or quests to quickly change between them
 New office art & store page art

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697663/8cbe44f85581ce49f4bde19c7e0b21247e5482a1.png

💖 Thanks for reading!
- Darz & Zal

notes.title: Version 1.1.1: Small clarity update + bug & crash fixes
notes.content:
There's a nice little update for all you NPCs today:

 Set the default font to CURVY for new players (since people find it easier to read, and by golly QG is a readin' game)
 Fixed a crash in The World Needs a Hero if Krol is killed early and the goblin quest is ignored, thanks to Kerolink for finding and reporting it! ːsteamthumbsupː
 Fixed some French and English typos
 Added a more noticeable scroll for important quest results:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44697663/92557eda6b75c937fe6776521485bfce611b06a9.png

In other news: we're up to nearly 17 000 global quests succeeded, well done everyone!

See you at the next update 💖
-Darzington & Zalinius

notes.title: Quest Giver 1.0 OUT NOW!
notes.content:
After 14 great months, it's release day!

📜 We can't wait to hear what people think, let us know which scenario is your favourite 😍

🪲 Going forward we intend to fix bugs as they are found, but you should know that this is all of the content that we have planned for Quest Giver. Enjoy!

Enough from us, it's time for you to:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44697663/3f2dded58e15d19da21d9def4383b3345cb2fa4e.gif

-Darzington & Zalinius 💖
